translation: Flavor sweet, non-toxic. It mainly nourishes the flesh, strengthens yin, firms the sinews and bones, mainly treats cold in the penis, spontaneous emission of essence, residual dribbling of urine, bitter mouth, and dryness and cold congealing blood into accumulations. One name is Tulü [菟縷], one name is [蒙], one name is Yunü [玉女], one name is Chiwang [赤網], one name is Tulei [菟累].
